reply.text: Yes — strength training is one of the best things an older adult can do, it's protective for bone density, balance and staying independent. Start conservative: lighter loads, good form, a few sets of each movement with reps left in the tank, and build from there. If you've got any conditions your doctor is tracking, get their clearance first so we train around anything that needs it. Tell me what you want to work on and I'll help you build toward it.
